argument_summary: The admissible record supports a narrower position than full clean compliance: aggregate readiness is above threshold and rehearsal showed no severity-one incidents, so launch readiness in general is supported, but the municipal permitting assistant remains a named launch use case with a 1.3 point evaluation miss and an open legal disclosure question. The supportable audit posture is therefore certification only as caveated compliance tied to an explicit launch-facing record that preserves the limitation, the evaluation result, and the monitoring posture, rather than escalation on the theory that certification is wholly unsupported.
claims_about_business_cost: No independent business-cost claim is needed to support this position. The relevant point is governance efficiency: where aggregate readiness is above threshold and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, remaining uncertainty can be handled through a bounded caveat and monitoring posture rather than immediate escalation, so long as the record does not overstate policy satisfaction.
claims_about_policy: The policy does not allow the non-core label to resolve materiality for a named launch use case, and the current record does not support claiming that documentation and monitoring override the disclosure rule. But the auditor can distinguish between clean compliance and caveated compliance: the admissible evidence supports that certification is defensible only if the packet is framed as preserving the unresolved limitation and not as showing the issue was immaterial or fully cleared. That narrows the claim instead of treating the entire certification decision as unsupported.
concessions: The present admissible record does not support a claim of full policy compliance without qualification.
The municipal permitting assistant segment is material under the stated policy because it is a named launch use case in two city pilot commitments.
There is no admissible evidence here of completed disclosure, issue resolution, or approved risk acceptance, and legal review remains open.
The product note describing the segment as non-core is insufficient to defeat materiality on this record.
